'''Saligon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] vendor and bartender at the [[Voss-Ka Cantina]] on [[Voss]].

During the [[Invasion of Voss]], Saligon hid in the [[Judicial Quarter]] Commerce Hall alongside [[Usuthas]] and a number of [[Voss (species)|Voss]].<ref name="Chapter 1">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=1}}</ref>
